name: gloss
description: Draws code fences as open-sided, labelled, highlighted blocks with a copy menu, mermaid diagrams as text, file:line references as links, inline code as theme-aware chips, lists, quotes, rules and strikethrough, diffs in colour, callouts and the Next: line as accented boxes.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons in a terminal with a Nerd Font (3.2 or newer), the Unicode glyphs elsewhere and in the desktop app. plain: the Unicode glyphs (✓ ● ━ ╭). text: ASCII stand-ins (v * = +) and classic borders, for a terminal or font that cannot show them. nerd: Nerd Font icons in the terminal even where no Nerd Font was found.
